raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a reticulonodular pattern with characteristic sparing of the costophrenic angles (and typically the medial middle lobe), which is a hallmark radiographic feature of Pulmonary Langerhans' Cell Histiocytosis; the presence of a unilateral pleural effusion (likely due to pneumothorax or inflammation) can also be associated with the disease.
